messages.app.confirmUncertainElevation: I confirm these values represent ground elevation and accept an unknown vertical datum.

messages.import.fileLimit: One file, up to {{importMaxMiB, number}} MiB

messages.map.basemapUnavailable: Basemap unavailable. You can still view and edit the route.

messages.issues.ROUTE_TOO_SHORT: The cleaned route needs at least two distinct points and a length of 0.1 m.
messages.issues.DUPLICATE_COORDINATES: Consecutive duplicate coordinates were merged without changing traversal order. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_CONFLICT: {{count, number}} repeated coordinates have conflicting elevations, now marked missing. In Elevation, fill interior gaps explicitly or use a corrected source file.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_MISSING: Some route points have no elevation. Zero elevation is preserved as valid data. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.LARGE_SOURCE_EDGE: Some adjacent source coordinates are more than 1 km apart. Check their connections on the map. Count: {{count, number}}.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_RESOURCE_LIMIT: The route exceeds the processing limit for route points. Select a shorter segment or use another file.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_QUANTIZATION_COLLISION: Coordinate precision cannot distinguish stage boundaries. Move a boundary station or disable its stage split.
messages.issues.GEOMETRY_QUANTIZATION_MERGE: Merged {{count, number}} route points that coincide after coordinate precision conversion.
messages.issues.INCOMPLETE_ELEVATION: A complete elevation profile is required. Select Fill gaps and export for interior gaps. Missing start or finish elevations, or a route with no known elevations, require a corrected source file.
messages.issues.PROFILE_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Elevation sampling exceeds {{profileNodeLimit, number}} nodes. Increase the sampling interval.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_RANGE: An elevation value exceeds the RTE signed 32-bit decimeter range.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_TOTAL_RANGE: Cumulative ascent or descent exceeds the RTE unsigned 32-bit decimeter range.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_LARGE_GAP: An elevation gap of {{distance, number}} m exceeds {{limit}} m. It has been filled and does not block export.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_FILLED: Estimated interior elevation gaps by interpolating between known values using along-route distance.
messages.issues.IDENTITY_INVALID: The route identity or revision is invalid.
messages.issues.ROUTE_NAME_INVALID: The route name must contain 1–96 UTF-8 bytes and no control characters.
messages.issues.DISTANCE_RANGE: The route distance is outside the RTE range.
messages.issues.OPTIONS_INVALID: Invalid settings: geometry tolerance {{geometryMinM}}–{{geometryMaxM}} m, elevation interval {{elevationIntervalMinM}}–{{elevationIntervalMaxM}} m, smoothing window {{smoothingMinM}}–{{smoothingMaxM}} m.
messages.issues.STATION_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm this station’s along-route visit before exporting. ({{name}})
messages.issues.STATION_NAME_INVALID: The name must use 1–96 UTF-8 bytes and the short label 1–16 UTF-8 bytes, with no control characters. ({{name}})
messages.issues.STATION_INVALID: A station has invalid event fields or coordinates. ({{name}})
messages.issues.EVENT_ID_DUPLICATE: Station event IDs must be unique.
messages.issues.ENDPOINT_EVENTS: Exactly one start and finish must be the first and last events, at zero and the total distance, both defining stage boundaries.
messages.issues.BOUNDARY_COLLISION: Stage boundaries coincide at 0.1 m precision. Change a boundary station’s distance or disable its stage split.
messages.issues.ELEVATION_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm that KML altitude values represent route ground elevation, or use a corrected source file.
messages.app.unconfirmedCount_one: {{count, number}} station position needs your confirmation.
messages.app.unconfirmedCount_other: {{count, number}} station positions need your confirmation.
messages.app.missingElevationCount_one: {{count, number}} reference point has unknown elevation.
messages.app.missingElevationCount_other: {{count, number}} reference points have unknown elevation.
messages.issues.IMPORT_SHORT_SEGMENT: “{{name}}” has fewer than two points and was skipped.
messages.issues.IMPORT_KML_ELEVATION: In Elevation, confirm KML altitudes represent ground elevation before using them. The exported vertical datum remains unknown.
messages.issues.IMPORT_MULTIPLE_SEGMENTS: Found {{count, number}} separate route segments. Select one to process; discontinuities are never automatically joined.
messages.app.routeConfirmationRequired: Return to Route and check the route and direction confirmation box.
messages.issues.title.ELEVATION_TOTAL_RANGE: Ascent or descent out of range
messages.issues.title.STATION_NAME_INVALID: Invalid station name or short label
messages.app.declinationHelp: Automatically query BGS WMM2025 using the route midpoint and selected UTC date. Only that coordinate and date are sent. Assumed WGS84 ellipsoid height: 0 m. If unavailable, the metadata is omitted. You can also enter a manual reference.
messages.app.declinationValidityHelp: Validity dates are optional. Fill both or leave both empty; the reference date must fall within the interval. Empty dates mean temporal applicability is unspecified.
messages.issues.MAGNETIC_DECLINATION_INVALID: Check declination (−180° to 180°), reference coordinates, valid reference date and source (1–64 UTF-8 bytes). Fill both validity dates or neither, and include the reference date in the interval.
messages.app.declinationUnavailable: Magnetic declination unavailable; it will be omitted. You can continue exporting. The service supports dates from 2025 through 2029.
messages.app.completeElevationRequired: RTE requires a complete elevation profile. Unknown start or finish elevation cannot be filled; use a corrected source file before exporting.
messages.bluetooth.title: Bluetooth upload
messages.bluetooth.help: Connect your device to upload this route directly over Bluetooth. Keep this page open and the device nearby.
messages.bluetooth.overwriteHelp: The directory must already exist. An existing file with the same name will be overwritten.
messages.bluetooth.cancelled: Upload cancelled. A partial file may remain on the device.
messages.bluetooth.unsupported: Bluetooth upload requires Chrome on a computer or Android. Use Download .rte in this browser.
messages.bluetooth.selectionCancelled: No device selected. Click Connect device to try again.
messages.bluetooth.connectionFailed: Could not connect. Check that Bluetooth is on and the device is nearby, then try again.
messages.bluetooth.serviceUnavailable: The device does not expose the mcumgr Bluetooth service. Check its firmware and select a compatible device.
messages.bluetooth.disconnected: Device disconnected. Connect again to upload.
messages.bluetooth.transferFailed: Bluetooth transfer failed. A partial file may remain. Reconnect the device and try again.
messages.bluetooth.timeout: The device did not respond in time. A partial file may remain. Reconnect and try again; check that its firmware supports mcumgr file uploads and Bluetooth packet reassembly.
messages.bluetooth.invalidResponse: The device returned an invalid response. Reconnect and try again.
messages.bluetooth.invalidOffset: The device did not confirm the expected file position. Upload stopped; reconnect to retry.
messages.bluetooth.busy: Another Bluetooth operation is in progress.
messages.bluetooth.invalidPath: Enter an absolute device file path without control characters.
messages.bluetooth.invalidDirectory: Enter an absolute directory, such as /SD:/ROUTES/. Do not use backslashes, control characters, . or .. segments.
messages.bluetooth.pathTooLong: The device file path is too long. Shorten the directory or file name.
messages.bluetooth.emptyFile: There are no route bytes to upload. Generate the route again.
messages.bluetooth.deviceError: The device rejected the upload. Check the directory, available storage and file permissions.
messages.bluetooth.deviceErrorDetails: The device rejected the upload (group {{group}}, code {{code}}). Check the directory, available storage and file permissions.
messages.app.elevationMissingSourceHelp: The route has no usable elevation. Correct the source file to continue.
messages.app.elevationMissingEndpointsHelp: The start or finish has no elevation. Correct the source file; these values cannot be filled.
messages.app.elevationGapsHelp_one: {{count, number}} source point has no elevation. Choose gap filling below or correct the source file.
messages.app.elevationGapsHelp_other: {{count, number}} source points have no elevation. Choose gap filling below or correct the source file.
messages.app.elevationConfirmationHelp: Review the ground-elevation confirmation below before using these heights.
messages.app.elevationFilledHelp: Missing interior heights were estimated. Advanced settings let you compare the source profile.
messages.app.elevationAwaitingRouteHelp: Gap filling is selected. Resolve the remaining issues before the profile can be generated.
messages.app.elevationCompleteHelp: No source heights are missing. You can keep the current sampling and smoothing settings.
messages.app.downloadFileHelp: Save a .rte file to this device.
messages.app.exportDeviceHelp: Connect a device to upload the route. The file is validated before transfer.
messages.app.savedToleranceNeedsReset: The saved tolerance is {{value}} m. The slider supports {{min}}–{{max}} m in {{step}} m steps. Restore the {{default}} m default to adjust it.
